name: Trousers & Bottoms
shortDescription: Tailored trousers, chinos and skirts cut to your rise, seat and leg shape.
fabricNotes: Wool suiting, cotton twill and chino cloth, and stretch-blend fabrics for tailored comfort.
highlights: Custom rise, taper and break length
Matching fabric to an existing jacket on request
body: Trousers fail more often on rise and seat than on anything else — two things a standard size chart can't account for. We measure both directly and cut accordingly.
Choose a flat-front or pleated cut, set your own break at the ankle, and pick a taper that matches how you actually want them to sit.
Bring in an existing jacket and we can match trousers to complete a suit, or build a stand-alone pair for everyday wear.
